### SubscriptionStatus

Normalised subscription lifecycle. Each gateway's own status is preserved verbatim in `providerStatus`. `cancelled`, `completed`, `expired` and `failed` are terminal.

| Constant | Value | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `SubscriptionStatus.Created` | `created` | Created, the customer has not authorised the mandate yet. |
| `SubscriptionStatus.PendingAuthorization` | `pending_authorization` | The customer approved; the bank or NPCI has not confirmed the mandate yet. |
| `SubscriptionStatus.Trialing` | `trialing` | Mandate is live and the first charge is scheduled for the future (free trial or delayed start). |
| `SubscriptionStatus.Active` | `active` | Mandate is live and charges are being collected. |
| `SubscriptionStatus.PastDue` | `past_due` | A charge failed and is being retried; the subscription is still alive. |
| `SubscriptionStatus.Halted` | `halted` | Retries are exhausted; no further automatic charges until the merchant or customer acts. |
| `SubscriptionStatus.Paused` | `paused` | Charging is paused by the merchant or the customer; can be resumed. |
| `SubscriptionStatus.Cancelled` | `cancelled` | Ended by the merchant, the customer or the bank. Terminal. |
| `SubscriptionStatus.Completed` | `completed` | All billing cycles were collected. Terminal. |
| `SubscriptionStatus.Expired` | `expired` | The authorisation link or the mandate lapsed. Terminal. |
| `SubscriptionStatus.Failed` | `failed` | Mandate setup was rejected or failed. Terminal. |

| Constant | Value | Meaning |

| `PaymentMethod.Upi` | `upi` | UPI Autopay mandate. |
| `PaymentMethod.Card` | `card` | Card standing instruction (e-mandate on card). |
| `PaymentMethod.ENach` | `enach` | eNACH / e-mandate on a bank account (net banking, debit card or Aadhaar authenticated). |
| `PaymentMethod.PhysicalNach` | `physical_nach` | Paper NACH mandate. |
| `PaymentMethod.NetBanking` | `netbanking` | Net banking (one-time payments only). |
| `PaymentMethod.Wallet` | `wallet` | A wallet (one-time payments only). |

### ScheduleStatus

Lifecycle of one scheduled subscription: pending_authorization (nothing is billed yet), active, paused, halted (retries exhausted), cancelled or completed (all cycles collected or the mandate ended).

| Constant | Value | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `ScheduleStatus.PendingAuthorization` | `pending_authorization` | Registered, but the customer has not authorised the mandate yet. `tick()` never notifies or charges a schedule in this state; it only enforces the optional authorisation timeout. |
| `ScheduleStatus.Active` | `active` | Billing: `tick()` advances the current cycle. |
| `ScheduleStatus.Paused` | `paused` | Billing suspended by the merchant or the gateway; can be resumed. |
| `ScheduleStatus.Cancelled` | `cancelled` | Stopped. Terminal. |
| `ScheduleStatus.Completed` | `completed` | Every cycle (`totalCycles`) was collected. Terminal. |
| `ScheduleStatus.Halted` | `halted` | A cycle exhausted its attempts, or the gateway halted the mandate. No further charges. |

### CycleStatus

Where one billing cycle is in its notify, charge and confirm state machine.

| Constant | Value | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `CycleStatus.Pending` | `pending` | Waiting for the pre-debit notification time (or the due time, if no notification is needed). |
| `CycleStatus.Notified` | `notified` | The gateway accepted the pre-debit notification; waiting for the debit time. |
| `CycleStatus.Charging` | `charging` | Persisted BEFORE `createCharge` is called. A cycle found in this state at the start of a tick means the outcome of the debit is unknown and must be reconciled with `getCharge`. |
| `CycleStatus.AwaitingConfirmation` | `awaiting_confirmation` | The gateway accepted the debit but has not reported the final result. |
| `CycleStatus.Succeeded` | `succeeded` |  |
| `CycleStatus.Failed` | `failed` | Every attempt failed. The schedule is halted. |
| `CycleStatus.Skipped` | `skipped` | Never debited (the schedule was cancelled first). |

### SchedulePauser

Who paused a schedule: `merchant` (only the merchant resumes it) or `gateway` (a gateway event; the gateway's own resume event resumes it).

| Constant | Value | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `SchedulePauser.Merchant` | `merchant` | The merchant (the facade's `pause`, or `scheduler.pause`). Only the merchant resumes it. |
| `SchedulePauser.Gateway` | `gateway` | The gateway or the customer, reported by a gateway event (a customer pausing a UPI mandate in their app). |
